Name: True Rune - Powerful Event Patcher
Author: Riou0903
Description:
[size=5][b]True Rune: Events — Powerful Event Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=3][i]Branching. Structured. Authorable. Custom heart events in JSON.[/i][/size]

[size=4][b]The pitch[/b][/size]

Drop [b]one JSON file per event[/b] and get branching choices, sub-events, fragments, conditional steps, and outcome tracking — all without writing a single line of C# or counting forward-slashes in raw event command strings.

True Rune: Events is the framework The Breathing Valley was built on, [b]extracted, generalized, and ready for your content[/b]. Author heart events the way they should have always been authored: one file, named fields, named choices, named outcomes.

[size=4][b]Works alongside Content Patcher[/b][/size]

Both mods edit [color=#9ACD32]Data/Events/*[/color] but at different layers. Content Patcher gives you raw command-string control. True Rune: Events gives you a [b]structured authoring DSL[/b]. You can use both side by side — TRE injects events whose preconditions Stardew evaluates exactly like any other event.

[size=4][b]What TRE adds beyond Content Patcher's EditData Data/Events/*[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Step-by-step JSON, not slash-delimited command soup.[/b] Every step is its own object with named fields. No counting separators.[/*]
[*][b]Branching is a first-class concept.[/b] [color=#9ACD32]quick_question[/color] with [color=#9ACD32]answers[/color] + [color=#9ACD32]branches[/color] arrays. The compiler emits the right [color=#9ACD32]quickQuestion #a#b(break)cmd1\\cmd2(break)…[/color] for you.[/*]
[*][b]Sub-events with automatic suppression.[/b] Declare [color=#9ACD32]is_sub_event: true[/color] and the framework pre-marks them as seen on save load so Stardew doesn't auto-fire them — reachable only via [color=#9ACD32]switch_event[/color] from a parent branch.[/*]
[*][b]Outcome tracking built in.[/b] Declare a [color=#9ACD32]mail_flag[/color] per outcome; the watcher polls [color=#9ACD32]mailReceived[/color] and marks the event complete automatically. No manual bookkeeping.[/*]
[*][b]Reusable fragments.[/b] Pull a sequence of steps into a named block and reference it with [color=#9ACD32]{ "op": "include", "fragment": "<name>" }[/color]. Cuts duplication in multi-variant events.[/*]
[*][b]`when` clauses on any step.[/b] Compile-time flag predicates ([color=#9ACD32]all[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]any[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]none[/color]) skip entire steps based on player history.[/*]
[*][b]Season + day-of-month gating.[/b] Add [color=#9ACD32]seasons[/color] and [color=#9ACD32]days[/color] to a precondition for date-window events (e.g. Spring 1-23, before the Flower Dance).[/*]
[*][b]Relationship & Flower Dance ops.[/b] [color=#9ACD32]set_relationship[/color] flips an NPC to Dating/Engaged/Married and [color=#9ACD32]set_dance_partner[/color] assigns a festival dance partner straight from JSON — no bouquet or item handed over.[/*]
[*][b]`emote_by_flag` step.[/b] Pick an emote based on prior choices without writing C# pickers.[/*]
[*][b]Per-event debug block.[/b] Add [color=#9ACD32]warp_x[/color]/[color=#9ACD32]warp_y[/color] and a [color=#9ACD32]scenarios[/color] map and you get [color=#9ACD32]rune_event_run <id> <scenario>[/color] for free — the testing loop content authors actually want.[/*]
[*][b]Self-validating.[/b] Numeric-id collisions caught at startup. Unknown mail-flag references warn at load.[/*]
[*][b]AI-friendly.[/b] The full authoring guide ships inside the zip — paste [color=#9ACD32]docs/EVENT_AUTHORING.md[/color] into Claude/ChatGPT with your synopsis and you get working JSON back.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Concrete comparison — same branching event in CP vs. TRE[/b][/size]

[b]Content Patcher approach[/b]: edit [color=#9ACD32]Data/Events/Town[/color] with one giant precondition→script string per event:

[code]
{
"Action": "EditData",
"Target": "Data/Events/Town",
"Entries": {
"9900004/f Robin 1500/e 9900003": "spring_day_ambient/45 65 true/farmer 45 68 0 Robin 45 66 2 skippable/pause 500/speak Robin \"Opening line.$h\"/quickQuestion #Of course! I'd love to.#Sorry, busy tonight.(break)addMailReceived MYPACK_LH04_accept\\friendship Robin 50\\end(break)addMailReceived MYPACK_LH04_decline\\friendship Robin 10\\end"
}
}[/code]
[b]What's hard:[/b]
[list]
[*]Where does the header end and the body start? (Count forward-slashes.)[/*]
[*]Add a new choice in the middle? Re-count the slash positions, escape the slash-vs-backslash separators correctly, and pray.[/*]
[*]Conditionally pause an extra second only if the player has a flag set? Stardew's vanilla precondition system can't do it inline — you'd need a second event entry with overlapping preconditions.[/*]
[*]Chain into a sub-event with [color=#9ACD32]switchEvent[/color]? Stardew will then [b]also[/b] try to auto-fire that sub-event in its own location. You'd need a separate mod to mark it seen.[/*]
[*]Test it without reloading the save? You can't — Stardew evaluates the dictionary on location entry, and once the event has fired you have to manually clear mail flags and event-seen entries.[/*]
[/list]
[b]The same event in TRE:[/b]

[code]
{
"id": "LH04",
"title": "Robin invites the player home",
"location": "Town",
"category": "linear",

"debug": { "warp_x": 45, "warp_y": 68 },

"outcomes": [
{ "mail_flag": "MYPACK_LH04_accept",  "description": "Accepted Robin's invite" },
{ "mail_flag": "MYPACK_LH04_decline", "description": "Politely declined"      }
],

"text_content": {
"LH04": [
{ "type": "lines",  "sort_order": 0, "speaker": "Robin", "emotion": "$h", "text": "Hey @, want to come over for dinner?" },
{ "type": "choices", "sort_order": 0, "choice_id": "yes", "text": "Of course! I'd love to." },
{ "type": "choices", "sort_order": 1, "choice_id": "no",  "text": "Sorry, busy tonight." }
]
},

"variants": [
{
"key": "default",
"section": "LH04",
"precondition": { "friendship_points": 1500, "npc_name": "Robin", "required_completed_event_ids": ["LH03"] },
"header": {
"music": "spring_day_ambient",
"viewport": { "x": 45, "y": 65, "clamp": true },
"farmer":  { "x": 45, "y": 68, "facing": "up" },
"actors":  [ { "name": "Robin", "x": 45, "y": 66, "facing": "down" } ]
},
"steps": [
{ "op": "pause", "ms": 500 },
{ "op": "speak", "sort_order": 0 },
{
"op": "quick_question",
"answers":  [ { "sort_order": 0 }, { "sort_order": 1 } ],
"branches": [
[ { "op": "add_mail", "flag": "MYPACK_LH04_accept"  }, { "op": "friendship", "npc": "Robin", "delta": 50 }, { "op": "end" } ],
[ { "op": "add_mail", "flag": "MYPACK_LH04_decline" }, { "op": "friendship", "npc": "Robin", "delta": 10 }, { "op": "end" } ]
]
}
]
}
]
}[/code]
[b]What you get from that:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Reads top-to-bottom like a story.[/b] Setup → header → steps → branches.[/*]
[*][b]Each step is independently editable.[/b] Insert a new pause? Drop one object into the [color=#9ACD32]steps[/color] array. Done.[/*]
[*][b]Branch outcomes are declared once and referenced everywhere.[/b] Add another outcome to [color=#9ACD32]outcomes[/color], the watcher picks it up automatically.[/*]
[*][b]Conditional step inclusion.[/b] Add [color=#9ACD32]"when": { "all": ["MYPACK_RELATIONSHIP_HOT"] }[/color] to any step and the framework skips it when the flag isn't set — no second event entry needed.[/*]
[*][b]Built-in test command.[/b] [color=#9ACD32]rune_event_run LH04[/color] warps you to the trigger spot and starts the event with one console command. No save reload.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]It just works the moment you install it[/b][/size]

The framework ships with one tiny smoke-test event ([color=#9ACD32]SMOKE01[/color]) for Robin in town — drop the mod in, raise Robin to 1 heart, and the next time you walk past her in town she'll confirm True Rune: Events is wired up correctly.

[size=4][b]Quick start for authors[/b][/size]

Your content pack is a standard SMAPI content pack:

[code]
MyEventPack/
├── manifest.json  (ContentPackFor: "Riou.TrueRune.Events")
└── TrueRune/
└── events/
├── linear/
│  └── LH04.json
└── interlude/
└── IN02.json[/code]
The [color=#9ACD32]TrueRune/[/color] umbrella keeps every True Rune Toolkit subsystem under one folder. If your pack also ships [color=#9ACD32]TrueRune/dialogue/[/color], the Dialogue framework picks those files up via the toolkit's cross-discovery — you only declare [color=#9ACD32]ContentPackFor[/color] once.

[b]manifest.json:[/b]

[code]
{
"Name": "My Event Pack",
"Author": "You",
"Version": "1.0.0",
"Description": "Adds new heart events for Robin.",
"UniqueID": "You.MyEventPack",
"ContentPackFor": {
"UniqueID": "Riou.TrueRune.Events",
"MinimumVersion": "1.0.0"
}
}[/code]
Drop the folder into [color=#9ACD32]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/color] → launch → walk to the trigger location. That's the whole loop.

[size=4][b]Schema reference (top-level)[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][color=#9ACD32]id[/color] — Event ID (e.g. [color=#9ACD32]LH04[/color])[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]title[/color] — Human label[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]location[/color] — Stardew location asset name ([color=#9ACD32]Town[/color], [color=#9ACD32]SeedShop[/color], [color=#9ACD32]Beach[/color], [color=#9ACD32]Farm[/color]…)[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]category[/color] — [color=#9ACD32]linear[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]sub[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]random[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]dating[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]married[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]season[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]mental_battle[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]interlude[/color][/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]owner_npc[/color] — NPC the event belongs to; drives per-NPC Full immersion + event-based relationships and supplies the heart-gate NPC when a precondition sets [color=#9ACD32]friendship_points[/color] without [color=#9ACD32]npc_name[/color]. Inferred from the first variant if omitted — set it explicitly on multi-NPC scenes.[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]numeric_id_base[/color] — Optional override for this event's numeric-ID base (collision avoidance)[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]auto_inject[/color] — [color=#9ACD32]false[/color] for interludes / manually-fired events[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]debug[/color] — Powers the [color=#9ACD32]rune_event_run[/color] debug command (warp coords + scenarios)[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]outcomes[/color] — Mail flags the engine watches for to mark the event complete[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]text_content[/color] — Embedded dialogue (lines, choices, monologues) keyed by section[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]fragments[/color] — Reusable named step sequences[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]variants[/color] — Branching paths (e.g. [color=#9ACD32]default[/color] + sub-event variants)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Schema reference (step ops)[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][color=#9ACD32]pause[/color] — Wait N ms[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]move[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]face[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]warp[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]jump[/color] — Move an actor[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]emote[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]emote_by_flag[/color] — Show an emote bubble (the second variant picks based on flags)[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]speak[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]monologue[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]text_above_head[/color] — Show dialogue from [color=#9ACD32]text_content[/color][/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]quick_question[/color] — Branching choice ([color=#9ACD32]answers[/color] + [color=#9ACD32]branches[/color] arrays)[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]friendship[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]add_mail[/color] — State changes[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]set_relationship[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]set_dance_partner[/color] — Set friendship status (Dating/Engaged/…) or the Flower Dance partner directly, no bouquet/item required[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]event_seen[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]switch_event[/color] — Chain into another event[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]change_location[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]global_fade[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]global_fade_to_clear[/color] — Stage transitions[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]animate[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]play_sound[/color] — Animation + sound[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]end[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]end_position[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]end_dialogue[/color] — Close out the event[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]raw[/color] — Drop a verbatim Stardew event command (escape hatch)[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]include[/color] — Inline a named fragment[/*]
[/list]
A complete worked example covering branching, fragments, and outcomes ships in [color=#9ACD32]samples/Sample-RobinFarmVisitPack/[/color] in the release zip. Full schema docs live in [color=#9ACD32]docs/EVENT_AUTHORING.md[/color] inside the zip.

[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.0+[/url][/*]
[*][i]Recommended:[/i] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for the in-game settings page[/*]
[*]Drop the unzipped folder into [color=#9ACD32]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/color][/*]
[*]Install any content pack that requires this framework[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Console commands (prefix rune_)[/b][/size]

· [color=#9ACD32]rune_event_run <eventId> [scenario][/color] — Force-trigger an event
· [color=#9ACD32]rune_event_unsee <eventId>[/color] — Mark an event unseen so it can fire again
· [color=#9ACD32]rune_event_eligible[/color] — Show eligibility status of every registered event
· [color=#9ACD32]rune_event_list[/color] — List every registered event grouped by owning content pack
· [color=#9ACD32]rune_event_reload[/color] — Re-scan every JSON file from disk and rebuild the registry without restarting SMAPI

Install [b]True Rune: Modder Toolkit[/b] for these commands plus generic portrait / list / dump helpers. For 1:1 state setters use vanilla [color=#9ACD32]debug seenMail[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]debug question[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]debug seenEvent[/color]. Without the Toolkit installed, this framework registers no console commands.

Type [color=#9ACD32]help rune_<name>[/color] in the SMAPI console for usage.

[size=4][b]C# API[/b][/size]

[code]
var api = Helper.ModRegistry.GetApi<IEventForgeApi>("Riou.TrueRune.Events");

// Register a brand-new step op so JSON authors can write { "op": "screen_flash" }
api.RegisterStepCompiler(new ScreenFlashCompiler());

// Claim a numeric-id prefix so your content pack's events never collide
api.RegisterNumericIdPrefix("FX", 9930000);

// Force-trigger an event from your own mod
api.TriggerEvent("LH04", scenario: "tour");[/code]
[size=4][b]Compatibility & permissions[/b][/size]

SMAPI 4.0+ / Stardew Valley 1.6+. Stacks alongside Content Patcher event edits and custom-NPC frameworks. [b]MIT licensed[/b] — use as a dependency without asking, fork freely, translations welcome.
